meta.name: Tansener Tanpura 1080p
meta.description:
Alap and Shruti are in a musical maze at the end of which exists the legendary Tanpura. Can they solve the historical riddles?

Returning Series · First aired 26 Jun 2020 · India · Language: English
Studio: Hoichoi · Network: hoichoi

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 9/9

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Swaralipi
videos.overview: Alap goes to take music lessons from his friend Shruti’s mother who is a well-known singer. But there’s something else that grabs his attention more than music.

videos.title: Jog-Sutra
videos.overview: Shruti tells Alap about her family's treasure after they meet an elderly singer. During Alap's practice, the picture he is curious about does something strange.

videos.title: Pancham Baad
videos.overview: Kedar narrates a story to Alap and Shruti about the Tanpura, but fails to complete his narration. But is that enough for Alap to start looking for a treasure?

videos.title: Tunabha Nali
videos.overview: Alap reaches a craftsman who's famous for making musical instruments to crack a riddle. Will he find yet another clue that will get him closer to the Tanpura?

videos.title: Hangsadhwani
videos.overview: Alap and Lalit both try to crack the next clue to find the Tanpura - and get locked in a battle of music. Who will win this challenge and find the next clue?

videos.title: Prashanna Biswas
videos.overview: There’s a new mystery at hand as Alap follows a clue to find out more about Prashanna Biswas. Little does he know that something terrible is about to happen.

videos.title: Masitkhani Gat
videos.overview: Madhubanti finds a historical book once stolen from the library. Alap and Shruti are led to a famous sitarist - but will they find another painting?

videos.title: Nawabi Khanjar
videos.overview: The story of young Hemanta and Lalit’s deadly quest for the Tanpura unfolds. Meanwhile, Alap digs deeper into the mystery - and unlocks his dark past.

videos.title: Snori Miyar Santan
videos.overview: Despite Madhubanti and Bahadur’s objections, Alap goes to the village looking for the Tanpura. He and Shruti meet another talented musician with a unique tale.

videos.title: Bangshporichay
videos.overview: Alap believes that the note Ramnidhi received after Kedar’s death holds the next clue. But as darker things are set in motion, will he lose track of the truth?

videos.title: Shri'r Putro
videos.overview: Alap finds an old diary, and together with Shruti, attend the funeral of the old beggar. He solves yet another clue to find Raag Sarang.

videos.title: Umrababi
videos.overview: Alap and Shruti start receiving clues that confuse them. At the same time they are sinisterly warned to not pursue this quest.

videos.title: Rai Dhairyang
videos.overview: The duo reaches Ranjan's residence where Shruti uncovers a dark secret. Ranjan promises a bandish to Alap that can lead him to the Tanpura

videos.title: Bilash Khan
videos.overview: Yet another word game begins. Alap is given another keyword that hides the mysterious quest of the Tanpura

videos.title: Jogyotomo Shishya
videos.overview: Alap visits Raunak Bai, a prostitute, who gives him an instrument crucial to this quest, leading him an inch closer to the Tanpura.

videos.title: Abarohon
videos.overview: Bahadur and Alap confront each other, where Bahadur reveals shocking facts about Rohini's past.

videos.title: Raag Deepak
videos.overview: Kedar takes up a grave task and starts learning to sing Raag Deepak, which causes death.

videos.title: Arohon
videos.overview: Alap and Hemanta get into a brawl. Madhubanti visits Rohini. The mysteries unfold.

videos.title: Miyan Ki Malhar
videos.overview: Following Rohini's clue, Alap and Shruti reach Saraswati Mandir which is filled with the final clues waiting to be decoded
